concepts.def: German industrial designer chief of design at Braun from 1961 to 1995, whose products shaped consumer electronics aesthetics.
Rams's list of qualities of good design, articulated in the 1970s and 1980s, including innovative, useful and aesthetic.

Rams's tenth principle advocating reduction to the essential, profoundly influencing Jonathan Ive's work at Apple.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Technical Principles — a core area of A-Level Design Technology.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Technical Principles brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Technical Principles.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
